keystroke_encoder.channel_merger: per-subject 2D Fourier ChannelMerger, 270 virtual channels, Fourier total_dim 2048, dropout 0.2

sentence_model.normalization: x-transformers default normalization; official config does not enable ScaleNorm/RMSNorm
sentence_model.output: same number of keystroke positions, 2048 dimensions

head_and_objective.head: Linear(2048, NUM_CLASSES)
head_and_objective.decoder: official character metric uses argmax/greedy-style predictions; optional separate KenLM script is not part of base neural training

feasibility.cpu: not practical for the exact architecture on the available laptop
feasibility.memory: high risk: 2048-wide 8-layer encoder plus 4-layer 2048-wide Transformer; Adam-style training requires multiple copies of parameters plus activations
feasibility.parameter_count: exact instantiation probe in the pinned environment terminated before producing a count; source configuration establishes a very large model dominated by the 2048-wide Transformer
feasibility.blocker: Exact official v1 uses a large per-keystroke encoder/channel merger and sentence Transformer, while the current local environment cannot safely instantiate the configured model for an eight-trial CPU experiment.

minimal_faithful_alternative.status: proposed only; not implemented or trained
minimal_faithful_alternative.structure_preserved: event encoder -> one vector per event -> sentence-level Transformer -> per-event character head
minimal_faithful_alternative.required_user_decision: Choose explicit reduced hidden/channel dimensions and record them as a separate approximation; it must not be called exact official v1.

interpretation: D. Inconclusive: exact hierarchical baseline was not trained because feasibility was not established; no transfer claim is made.
